text:
ava: Heads-up — noticed billing vs dashboard delta after yesterday's ingestion outage. Some invoices show higher token counts for select customers. Link: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/metering
ops-bot: alert: pipeline_ingest lagged ~14h between 2026-03-14T01:00Z and 2026-03-14T15:00Z. auto-replay queued.
sanjay: Which topics affected? tokens, embeddings, or both?
maria: Looks like token events. Replayed events had a dedupe gate that dropped events with identical request_id during outage window — suspect double-apply or drop.
ryan: Billing reporting shows tokens > dashboard by ~9.2M tokens across 3 customers. We got 2 escalations this morning.
ingest-bot: replay-job started: id=rbk-20260314-77, scheduled at 2026-03-15T02:00Z. Current state: queued.
ava: Plan proposal:
1) run replay with --write-events --preserve-request-id to generate candidate events
2) run reconciliation query per-customer to compute delta
3) if delta > threshold, hold invoices and issue provisional credits
4) run dedupe pass on downstream metering store and re-ingest missing events
Commands:
```
./tools/replay --job rbk-20260314-77 --start "2026-03-14T01:00Z" --end "2026-03-14T15:00Z" --preserve-request-id --chunk-size 10000
```
Reconciliation SQL:
```
SELECT customer_id, SUM(tokens) as replay_tokens
FROM metering_events_replay
WHERE replay_job = 'rbk-20260314-77'
GROUP BY customer_id;
```
sanjay: For replay we need to throttle so we don't overwhelm the metering write path. Suggest concurrency=4 and per-customer backoff. Also watch KV cache ordering — duplicates could appear if request_id preserved.
maria: I reproduced missing-token behavior in staging with the following steps:
1) start a synthetic load with identical request_id across retries
2) kill ingestion for ~30s
3) restore ingestion
Logs:
```
ingest-consumer[2026-03-14T02:12:15Z] WARN Dropped event request_id=abc123 duplicate=true
```
I think the dedupe gate was too aggressive when the consumer restarted.
ryan: Customer list: cust_42, cust_99, cust_201 — PMs pinged. We need customer-facing note and possible credits.
billing: please add cust_99 to provisional credit queue if reconciliation delta > 500k tokens.
ava: Assignments:
- sanjay: run the replay and throttle controls (owns run)
- maria: write dedupe-fix patch and staging repro
- ryan: coordinate billing holds and customer comms
- ava: own reconciliation query + dashboard update
Schedule: start replay 2026-03-15T02:00Z, expect initial pass 6-8h, follow-on dedupe + reingest 2-4h.
ingest-bot: replay-job rbk-20260314-77 -> running (workers 4/4)
ops-bot: created incident tracking board https://redwood.internal/incidents/1769554321
sanjay: quick note — if replay shows negative delta for any customer (dashboard > invoice), abort and file a separate ticket. We don't want double-credit.
maria: pushing patch to staging now, will open PR and tag @sanjay for validation.
ryan: I'll draft a customer note template and share in #support-desk.
billing: added cust_99 to provisional-credit list (ticket #BILL-502)
ava: I'll run the reconciliation query hourly and paste updated deltas here. First run once replay finishes initial chunk.
ingest-bot: update: 2026-03-15T04:30Z partial replay completed (20%): approx 1.8M tokens reprocessed.
ava: thanks — keep updates short here. If anyone sees >1M token delta for a customer, call it out.
ryan: +1
sanjay: starting the replay now, concurrency=4, per-customer backoff enabled. will post job logs.
ingest-bot: log snippet:
```
worker-2 INFO requeued 1200 events for cust_42
worker-3 INFO applied 4500 events to metering-store
```
ops-bot: monitoring alert rule created: metering.replay.failed > 3 triggers slack @eng-oncall
maria: PR #1423 created with dedupe threshold fix. tagging @ava for deploy after validation.
ava: great. once validated we can run dedupe pass and re-ingest missing. Keep a changelog of ids processed.
ryan: customer comms ready in draft. Holding invoices until reconciliation completes. Will update finance.
sanjay: ETA to finish full replay ~7h from start assuming current throughput.
ava: last note — please include the following fields in reconciliation exports: request_id, original_ts, token_count, customer_id, source_instance
ava: I'll post the first reconciliation CSV here when available.
ingest-bot: replay-job rbk-20260314-77 completed: total_replayed_tokens=9,345,120 job_time=7h12m
ava: ran reconciliation, deltas:
- cust_42: +4,102,300 tokens
- cust_99: +3,200,450 tokens
- cust_201: +1,042,370 tokens
ryan: filing invoice adjustments and provisional credits for these three. sending customer notes now.
billing: updated billing ledger with provisional credits. ticket #BILL-502 updated.
ava: postmortem action items:
- harden dedupe gate to tolerate consumer restarts
- add replay dry-run mode for token estimation
- add per-customer replay dashboards
- add synthetic-test to catch request_id regressions
sanjay: I'll own the replay tooling improvements.
maria: I'll own the dedupe gate changes and tests.
ryan: I'll own billing reconciliation docs and customer templates.
ava: thanks everyone. closing thread when postmortem is published. :white_check_mark:
